title: Core web launch certification suite
goal: Certify the exact deployed staging release SHA across every core user, authorization, commerce, realtime, accessibility, and performance journey

in: Authentication, personas, discovery, events, ticketing, marketplace, messaging, uploads, and account deletion E2E
Negative authorization, webhook replay, concurrency, accessibility, responsive browser, and performance scenarios
out: Mobile launch certification and deferred advanced music/governance capabilities

acceptance_criteria: All core launch journeys pass against the exact staging release SHA using synthetic data and Stripe test mode
Cross-role, cross-user, and cross-tenant denial scenarios pass with no accidental skips
Webhook replay, transaction concurrency, accessibility, responsive-browser, and performance gates pass
No unresolved P0/P1 defect remains and evidence is attached to the certified release SHA
